title: Corbell presses Jacques Vallée on Lazar at his ranch

tellings.quote: things. I pushed him on it once at my ranch alone.

plain: A filmmaker named Jeremy Corbell says he once pushed the veteran UFO researcher Jacques Vallée on the subject of Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft, when the two of them were alone at Corbell's ranch. Corbell tells Michels about it as something he did himself, but he does not say what Vallée answered.
